definitions.explanation: The construction or building of a castle or fortress. A key concept in Japanese history, particularly during the Sengoku (Warring States) period.

examples.japanese: {築城|ちくじょう}に{三|さん}{年|ねん}かかった。
examples.english: It took three years to build the castle.

examples.japanese: {豊臣|とよとみ}{秀吉|ひでよし}は{大坂城|おおさかじょう}の{築城|ちくじょう}を{命|めい}じた。
examples.english: Toyotomi Hideyoshi ordered the construction of Osaka Castle.

examples.japanese: {戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}には{各地|かくち}で{築城|ちくじょう}が{盛|さか}んに{行|おこな}われ、{防御|ぼうぎょ}のための{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{発達|はったつ}した。
examples.english: During the Warring States period, castle construction flourished throughout the country, and defensive technologies advanced.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily a historical term associated with Japanese medieval and early modern history. The art and science of {築城|ちくじょう}{術|じゅつ} (castle-building techniques) was highly developed in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {築城|ちくじょう}する (to build a castle)
- {築城|ちくじょう}{技術|ぎじゅつ} (castle-building technology)
- {築城|ちくじょう}{術|じゅつ} (the art of castle construction)
- {築城|ちくじょう}の{名手|めいしゅ} (master castle builder)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {城郭|じょうかく}: castle, fortress — the structure itself
- {城下町|じょうかまち}: castle town — the town that develops around a castle
